label: 🌍 Earth today
blurb: Baseline — the only planet we know hosts life.
callout: Use this as the calibration anchor. Everything else compares to here.

label: 🟥 Mars today
blurb: Cold, thin air, no magnetosphere. A frozen desert.
callout: Watch the pressure veto fire — 0.006 atm can't hold liquid water.

label: 🟧 Venus today
blurb: Runaway greenhouse — surface hot enough to melt lead.
callout: 92 atm of CO₂ + slow retrograde spin → 462 °C and lethal.

label: 🟧 Titan today
blurb: Methane lakes and a thick orange smog under a small sun.
callout: Pre-biotic chemistry playground — but methane is the only available solvent.

label: 🔴 Proxima Centauri b
blurb: Earth-mass world tidally locked to a flaring red dwarf.
callout: Closest exoplanet — but flares + tidal locking gut its surface biosphere prospects.

label: 🌊 TRAPPIST-1 e
blurb: Rocky habitable-zone world around an ultracool M-dwarf.
callout: Best near-term JWST target — does a strong magnetic field save it?

label: 🟦 LHS 1140 b
blurb: Dense super-Earth around a quiet old M-dwarf.
callout: Quiet host star + thick atmosphere = one of the strongest HZ candidates.

label: 🟡 Teegarden's Star b
blurb: ESI ≈ 0.95 — among the most Earth-like by index alone.
callout: Old, quiet M-dwarf — fewer flares, but tidal locking is still on the table.

label: 🌍 Kepler-452 b
blurb: Super-Earth in the HZ of an older, brighter sun-like star.
callout: Heavy gravity (~1.6 g) + older star — Earth's cousin, but a tough hike.

label: 🪐 Hot Jupiter (51 Peg b analog)
blurb: Gas giant cooked at 0.05 AU — molten silicate clouds.
callout: First exoplanet ever found (1995). No surface. Glowing day side.

label: 🌊 Deep ocean world
blurb: Earth-mass world with a 100-km-deep global ocean.
callout: Could life evolve complex traits with no land at all?

label: ❄️ Snowball Earth
blurb: Earth as a fully glaciated ice ball, ~700 Myr ago.
callout: Even at 1 AU, the right atmosphere can freeze you solid.

label: 🛠 Terraformed Mars
blurb: Thicken the atmosphere, add a magnetic shield, warm it up.
callout: Even with the L1 shield, Mars's low gravity leaks atmosphere over Myr timescales.

label: 🧬 Seeded Titan
blurb: Drop extremophile microbes into Titan's methane lakes.
callout: Earth's biochemistry would have to rewrite itself for a methane solvent.

label: 🟠 K-dwarf paradise
blurb: Earth-twin around a quiet K-star — flare-quiet, billion-year stability.
callout: Many astrobiologists think K-dwarf HZ planets are even better than Earth.
